speaker: client
text: With the smaller capacity, please make one additional adjustment: the bowls should be easy to remove and quick to swap. That will let me prepare bowls in advance and exchange them rapidly during events.

speaker: freelancer
text: To accommodate the new spout and solenoid valve, I’ve revised the original build plan while keeping its general approach. A stainless-steel bulkhead threads into the opening at the bottom of the bowl, and a stainless-steel nipple attached to it forms a quick-release mechanism so the bowls can be swapped easily. Sliding that nipple into the silicone plug creates a watertight seal. On the plug’s opposite side, a 3/4 inch 90 degree connector leads to the solenoid valve. Pressing the button will actuate that valve and dispense the matcha through the stainless-steel spout.

speaker: client
text: From the CAD images of the base, can you tell whether the whiskers will be removable?

speaker: freelancer
text: Yes, the whiskers will be removable. The motor-mounting height is still being finalized, and it will probably need to be raised somewhat to leave enough clearance for removing the bowl and similar items.
